# 💡 the Decentralized Trust Graph (DTG)
**concept** · shared · knowledge

The relationship layer issued native on Archon did:cid / VC 2.0: VRC (relationship) · VMC (membership) · VIC (invitation) · VPC (persona) · VEC (endorsement) · VWC (witness) · RCard (contact card). Policy lives in a two-faced TRQP trust registry (authorizes issuers outward · grades a Witness's autonomy inward), not the credential. Specified upstream as the ToIP DTG Credentials Core Specification: six DTGCredential types on four DID roles (R/M/C/P), with two ZK constructions — pairwise (prove the edge, hide the R-DIDs) and community-anchored (edge + membership under one C-DID, personhood carried forward); the ZK layer itself is deferred to the DTG ZKP Task Force.

## Edges in

- [[OpenVTC Verifiable Trust Infrastructure]] *references* →
- [[the Witness 👁️ (Mage, built)]] *requires* →

- [[the Hitchhikers Field Guide (ARWorld)]] *implements* →
- [[The Field Guide Counter-Spec]] *extends* →
- [[the Meet Rite]] *implements* →
- [[the pairwise peer reference]] *implements* →
